slack.description: Slack official MCP server — B-Stock workspace (bstocksolutions.slack.com), user-scoped token (acts as Mike). Agents: call with --no-oauth; if issue.kind is 'auth', tell Mike to run 'mcporter auth slack' in a terminal.
